name: NYC street furniture, roaches and skateboard riders
style_profile: Hopan original PS1 low-poly NYC at gameplay camera distance

requirements.text: Ten distinct street furniture and skate feature models.
Segmented six-leg roach and three visually distinct riders.
Four-unit local -Z ramp and rail with .7/.65 heights; actual board truck underside .045 and rail actor elevation .605.

stages.title: Brief and contact contract
criteria: Declare 1.8-unit tile scale, local -Z forward and rail/board contacts.

stages.title: Primary silhouettes
criteria: Distinct 10 props, segmented roach and 3 rider profiles.

stages.title: Secondary assemblies
criteria: Slatted bench, open trash can, cart oven, wheel pivots, roach legs and rider joints.

stages.title: Mechanical hierarchy
criteria: Stable skate wheel, arm/leg and six roach leg pivots, ramp top normals.

stages.title: Distinctive detail
criteria: Pizza, papers, hood/hat/mohawk, street furniture and grind arrows.

stages.title: Palette and batching compatibility
criteria: Muted original PS1 colors, cached meshes/materials and independent moving nodes.

stages.title: Independent visual review
criteria: Inspect actual front/side/threequarter views and in-game readability.

stages.title: Runtime integration
criteria: Verify models in plaza and existing streets with collisions and enemies.

stages.title: Motion handoff
criteria: Actor simulation owns movement, named pivots receive animation.
